title: Simplified Naturalization and Dual Citizenship in Practice
grammar: Concessive contrast with dacára and jóllehet ('in spite of / notwithstanding / although')
goal: I can explain the background and practical reality of Hungary's simplified naturalization act.
I can use annak dacára, hogy... and jóllehet to express formal concessive contrast and nuance.
I can discuss dual citizenship, passport applications, emotional ties, and diplomatic complexities.
